Review_Text: The app update fixed all the crashing. Excellent and rock solid during load shedding now.
Instant EFT cleared in seconds again. Excellent as always.
New queue system at the branch meant ten minutes max. Impressed.
Cardless withdrawal with my phone worked first time. Love it.
Still getting charged for notice deposits. Fees are disappointing.
Payroll EFT batch processed same day. Smooth and reliable.
ATM was out of service for maintenance on payday. Very annoying.
Teller helped reverse a double debit order with a smile. Great service.
The app now lets me freeze my card instantly. Fantastic feature.
My transfer was delayed overnight. Still not happy about that.
WhatsApp banking handled my beneficiary payment end to end. Brilliant.
Youth Day crowd was big but staff kept the queue moving. Impressive.
Withdrew R300 for the long weekend at the campus ATM.
App performance on old phones is still slow. Frustrating for my mother.
Merchant support call resolved in eight minutes. Excellent.
School fee payment cleared instantly. Quick and easy.
The larger font option in settings is so helpful and easy. Great improvement.
Business account statements were wrong for a week. Disappointed.
Cash deposit machine rejected four of my notes. Very annoying.
Chatbot answered my campus card query perfectly. Love the speed.
Load shedding hit for four hours and the app never went down. Great work.
Grant day queue was managed so well this month. Excellent.
Called about a suspicious debit and got help immediately. Impressed.
My shared flat electricity payment bounced twice. Terrible.
The ATM gave me R100 short but the branch fixed it same day. Happy with the fix.
Invoice upload finally works on the app. Great improvement for business.
The WhatsApp prompts are simpler now. Easy to follow, thank you.
Consultant explained the new savings product clearly. Helpful.
Night deposit for my shop at the branch deposit slot before closing.
My card was blocked by fraud systems wrongly. Very frustrating experience.
Same-day settlement on the new EFT rails is fantastic.
Waited 15 minutes on hold about my statement. Annoying.
Agent reset my online banking in minutes. Great support.
Loaded beneficiaries on WhatsApp without any problems. Easy.
Branch ATM deposit window closed early. Disappointed.
I still struggle with the app menus. Confusing for pensioners.
Split the bill with three friends instantly. Love this.
Drew cash for the school cake sale at the branch ATM.
Month-end recon on the app took half the time. Excellent update.
Withdrew my grant money at the post office ATM. Transaction completed.
